The double blind placebo controlled trial included an open label extension.

A case control trial evaluated first line treatment.

The long term outcome was assessed using a risk adjusted analysis.

Each participant completed a self administered questionnaire at the follow up visit.

The previously-treated population experienced closely-related events.
